rv.q: Director Darko Tresnjak and lead actor Jefferson Mays deliver a revival of 'The Visit' that filled me with gratitude — gratitude for the high-level production, gratitude for making the case for why the play still matters.
And with lead performances like Mays' and Hamilton's, the production is — sorry to do this here — worth your visit.
The Visit is an absorbing and timely indictment of that oxymoron called humanity.
